_meta.name: PSBDx GDPR Cookie Shield – Cookie Context Library
_meta.description: External cookie knowledge base used by the PSBDx GDPR Cookie Shield WordPress plugin to enrich automatically scanned cookies with accurate provider, purpose, category and expiry information.
schema_notes: Each entry in 'cookies' represents one known cookie or cookie name prefix.
'prefix_match': true  → name is matched with str_starts_with() so e.g. '_ga' matches '_ga_G-XXXXXXX'.
'expiry' is a human-readable string, e.g. 'Session', '2 years', '30 min'.
'type' is one of: HTTP, HTML (localStorage), IndexedDB, Pixel.
'regulation_notes' is an optional array of compliance references.
